title: Reviewed capture and bounded curation
description: Evaluate selective memory capture and source-preserving curation by storing durable content, leaving low-signal content unstored, and distinguishing duplicate, evolving, related, and unrelated records.
context: Nora keeps a quiet personal notebook about ordinary routines, drawing, cooking, and evening habits. Over several weeks, she has accumulated short reflections, repeated observations, and practical notes in one evaluation account.
